signal_types.label: Manual / DIY lyobead production at capacity
signal_types.description: The company is producing lyophilised beads by hand, with a home-built rig, or with improvised equipment, and has hit or is approaching a throughput ceiling. This is the single highest-converting signal and it appears in no public source — it arrives only through human observation: a conversation, a LinkedIn reply, a trade show chat. Treat any mention of DIY, in-house-built, manual, or "we make them ourselves" bead production as this signal.
examples: built their own contraption for beads
dripping by hand, can't keep up with demand

signal_types.label: Job posting: assay dev, reagent formulation, lyophilisation
signal_types.description: An open role in assay development, reagent formulation, lyophilisation, freeze-drying, or drug product / MSAT work. Hiring in these functions means the company is building or expanding exactly the capability both products serve.

signal_types.label: New lyo capacity / fill-finish line / sterile injectable site
signal_types.description: Investment in lyophilisation capacity: a new freeze-dryer, a fill-finish line, a sterile injectable facility, or expansion of an existing lyo suite. Directly implies cycle development work, which is what the freeze-drying microscope serves.

signal_types.label: Competitor dissatisfaction
signal_types.description: The company uses a competing instrument and is unhappy with it — reliability, support, throughput, data quality, or cost. Human-observed only. Also covers a company that bought a competitor's unit previously and is now re-evaluating.
examples: they have a competitor unit and hate it
unhappy with their current supplier's service
lost to a competitor in 2024, now re-engaging

signal_types.label: Moving from cake/vial format to bead format
signal_types.description: The company is shifting, or evaluating a shift, from lyophilised cake or vial format to a unit-dose bead format. A deliberate format decision that only the bead generator serves.
examples: looking at moving from vials to beads
evaluating unit-dose bead format for the new panel

signal_types.label: Regulatory submission (510(k) / De Novo / EUA / CE-IVDR)
signal_types.description: A diagnostic regulatory filing or clearance — FDA 510(k), De Novo, EUA, or CE marking under IVDR. Indicates a product approaching or entering commercial manufacture, where reagent stability and unit-dose format decisions get made.

signal_types.label: New assay, kit or panel launch
signal_types.description: Launch or announced launch of a new assay, test kit, or multiplex panel. Commercial manufacture of reagents follows.
examples: launched a new multiplex respiratory panel

signal_types.label: Phase 1 entry, parenteral biologic format
signal_types.description: A biologic or parenteral drug candidate entering Phase 1. Formulation and lyophilisation cycle design work happens around this point.
examples: entered Phase 1 with their lead biologic

signal_types.label: Multi-product pipeline disclosed
signal_types.description: The company has disclosed multiple products or programmes in development. A repeat-buyer indicator: more programmes means more formulation work and a higher chance of a second and third unit. Structural — does not decay.

signal_types.label: ISO 13485 / cleanroom / facility expansion
signal_types.description: ISO 13485 certification, cleanroom build-out, or general manufacturing facility expansion. Signals a move from development toward regulated commercial production.

signal_types.label: Funding round with scale-up or commercialisation language
signal_types.description: A funding round where the stated use of proceeds mentions scale-up, manufacturing, or commercialisation. A QUALIFIER, not a trigger — it indicates affordability and scaling intent. Never surface a company on funding alone.
examples: raised Series B to scale manufacturing

signal_types.label: Grant award (SBIR, Innovate UK, EU Horizon)
signal_types.description: A non-dilutive grant award — SBIR/STTR, Innovate UK, EU Horizon, or similar. Same qualifier logic as funding: money exists and a specific programme is funded.
examples: Innovate UK grant for diagnostic development

signal_types.label: Publication mentioning reagent stability or freeze-drying
signal_types.description: A paper, preprint or poster from the company touching reagent stability, ambient/cold-chain-free shipping, lyophilisation, or freeze-drying. Evidence that someone there is working the problem.

signal_types.label: Conference presentation or exhibition
signal_types.description: The company is presenting at or exhibiting at a relevant conference (lyophilisation, formulation, IVD, diagnostics). Weak on its own; useful as a compounding signal and as a reason to make contact.
